app_tagline: Track your films, series and books on an instance you host yourself.
footer_not_affiliated: Selfboxd is not affiliated with Letterboxd.
setup_intro: This is the first launch of this instance. The account you create now administers it.
hint_username: 2 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error_username_invalid: The username must be 2 to 30 characters long and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
error_password_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
error_forbidden: You do not have access to this page.
auth_password_changed: Your password has been changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.
auth_sessions_intro: Browsers and devices currently signed in to your account.
accounts_password_set: The password of {username} has been changed.
avatar_intro: Your picture is cropped to a square, resized and stripped of its metadata before it is stored.
error_image_invalid: This file is not a supported image.
error_image_too_large: This image is too large. The limit is 10 MB.
search_prompt: Search for a film by its title.
film_watch_none: Not available on any service in your country.
tmdb_not_configured_admin: Add a TMDB API key in the settings to load films.
tmdb_not_configured_user: The administrator of this instance has not added a TMDB API key yet.
error_tmdb_unauthorized: TMDB rejected the API key of this instance.
error_tmdb_rate_limited: TMDB is receiving too many requests. Try again in a moment.
error_tmdb_unavailable: TMDB could not be reached. Try again later.
error_tmdb_key_invalid: TMDB did not accept this key.
instance_tmdb_intro: Selfboxd loads films and series from TMDB with your own API key. Create one for free in the API settings of your TMDB account, then paste the API Read Access Token or the API key here.
instance_tmdb_saved: The TMDB key has been saved.
